entries.name: Condensation
entries.summary: A fogged window over a photograph that the pointer wipes clear; scrolling completes the wipe, then pushes through the window frame into the sharp image and a closing headline.

entries.name: Cyanotype
entries.summary: A pinned sun-print workbench: drag plant cuttings onto coated paper, hold a button to expose it on a 2D canvas, then scroll to rinse the print blue and hang it on a dark wall.

entries.name: Evergrid About Us Features 01
entries.summary: Numbered three-step story: portrait image left, text and checklist right, joined by a centre rail whose dark fill tracks scroll past numbered nodes.

entries.name: Evergrid About Us Features 02
entries.summary: Dark-green split panel: serif claim top-left, one oversized statistic with a small unit bottom-left, and a large captioned photo on the right.

entries.name: Evergrid About Us Other 01
entries.summary: Open-roles careers block: centred heading over a 2x2 grid of translucent frosted cards on a green-washed landscape photo, each with title, terms, blurb and a full-width outline pill.

entries.name: Evergrid About Us Team 01
entries.summary: Three-column team grid of tall rounded portraits with a row of circular social buttons overlaid on the photo and a serif name plus small role line beneath.

entries.name: Evergrid Blog Blog 01
entries.summary: Three-column blog index of bordered cards: square rounded image flush to the top, serif two-line title, grey excerpt and a small text footer, with a slide-up reveal.

entries.name: Evergrid Blog Hero 01
entries.summary: Blog landing hero: centred serif title and intro, then one wide featured-post card with the image on the left and title, excerpt and bottom-pinned date on the right.

entries.name: Evergrid Case Studies Use Cases 01
entries.summary: Case-study index: centred serif headline over a three-column grid of tall full-bleed photo cards with client logo and title at the top and a named contact plus round arrow at the bottom.

entries.name: Evergrid Contact Contact 01
entries.summary: Contact page block: a large rounded deep-green panel on cream holding a tag pill, serif title and a white form card with cream fields and a full-width pill submit.

entries.name: Evergrid Home CTA 01
entries.summary: Closing call to action over a full-bleed aerial photo that fades from the cream page at the top into deep green at the bottom, with centred serif headline, line of copy and one light button.

entries.name: Evergrid Home FAQ 01
entries.summary: Cream-panel FAQ: left-aligned serif heading, a stack of white full-width question bars with plus icons, and a closing contact row with a pill button.

entries.name: Evergrid Home Features 01
entries.summary: Problem-statement feature block: left column with serif heading, three icon-led pain points and a closing line; right side a staggered three-row collage of rounded photos and one text tile.

entries.name: Evergrid Home - Features 02
entries.summary: Alternating two-column feature rows on cream: a square photo tile with a frosted chart card floating on it, opposite a serif heading, muted paragraph and three green-check bullets.

entries.name: Evergrid Home - Footer 01
entries.summary: Closing block on one dark-green surface: an aerial photo band with a centred serif headline and button that fades down into a quiet footer of logo plus three link columns.

entries.name: Evergrid Home - Hero 01
entries.summary: Centred serif-headline SaaS hero on cream: star row, status pill, two-line headline, one pill CTA, then a wide photo panel holding a frosted-framed dashboard shot beside a tall stat card.

entries.name: Evergrid Home - Navigation 01
entries.summary: A floating cream pill navbar: leaf logo and wordmark on the left, four plain text links on the right, the current page in a heavier weight. No button, no dropdowns in the still.

entries.name: Evergrid Home - Product Showcase 01
entries.summary: Image wall on dark green: three rows of rounded landscape photos with staggered seams and edge-cropped tiles, and a large washed centre tile carrying a two-line serif statement.

entries.name: Evergrid Home - Use Cases 01
entries.summary: Left-aligned serif title and intro above three tall photo cards; each card carries a client logo, a serif outcome headline, a named person and a white circular arrow button.

entries.name: Evergrid Pricing - Pricing 01
entries.summary: Three equal dark-green plan cards on cream under a centred serif headline: name, blurb, big price, white pill CTA and two labelled check-lists, with a recommended tag and a full-width help strip below.

entries.name: Evergrid Product - Features 01
entries.summary: Alternating feature rows for a product page: square photo tiles hold either a corner-cropped dashboard screenshot or a frosted stack of metric cards, beside a serif heading, paragraph and check-list.

entries.name: Evergrid Product - Hero 01
entries.summary: Dark-green rounded hero panel with nav inside it, a centred serif headline, a light pill CTA, a dashboard screenshot rising from the bottom edge, floating circular icon badges, and a logo strip beneath.

entries.name: Evergrid Product - How It Works 01
entries.summary: Three-step process block: centred serif title, a hairline with three numbered dark discs, and three tall dark-green cards each with an icon, step name, short description and a bottom-anchored bullet list.

entries.name: Evergrid Product - Integrations 01
entries.summary: Integrations banner on a misty forest photo: a frosted panel with a green app-icon tile, serif title, one-line pitch and a light pill CTA, above two offset rows of frosted logo tiles cropped at the edges.

entries.name: Florilegium
entries.summary: A pinned horizontal filmstrip of ten photo plates: vertical scroll slides the strip, the centred plate swells, a big clock ticks through the day, and the last plate expands to a full-bleed finale.

entries.name: Herbarium
entries.summary: A desk of twelve throwable, flippable specimen cards that scroll sorts from a loose pile into a tidy index grid, then zooms one card to a full-bleed closing image.

entries.name: Joiner
entries.summary: One photograph shown as a photo-joiner collage of dozens of misregistered prints that react to the pointer and can be re-shot by clicking; scroll aligns them into a seamless image that fills the screen.

entries.name: Phototropism
entries.summary: A line-drawn canvas meadow whose stems, grass and even the headline letters lean toward the cursor-as-sun; click to plant, and scroll runs the day from cream morning through dusk to a firefly night.

entries.name: Pigment
entries.summary: A paper-toned hero you spray with grainy pigment by moving the pointer; scroll blooms the ambient stains, shrinks the surface into a rounded certificate card, and lets you download the result as a PNG.

entries.name: Collage
entries.summary: Photographer portfolio hero as an endless, draggable table of prints: category labels are tied to their photos by live hairlines, a switch re-flows scatter into a filmstrip, and thumbnails fly into a lightbox.

entries.name: Folio
entries.summary: Writer-illustrator portfolio hero staged as a small printed magazine: a 3D book whose pages bend and cast shadows as you drag, click or key through cover, contents, essay, work, press and contact spreads.

entries.name: Vinyl
entries.summary: Musician portfolio hero built around a CSS turntable: pressing play slides the record out of its sleeve, drops the tonearm and starts a generated beat with a radial spectrum; the disc can be scratched by hand.

entries.name: Choice
entries.summary: Pricing as a mobile checkout sheet: three radio plan cards where the chosen one unfolds, a monthly/yearly segmented control, a seat stepper, and a 'due today' total whose digits roll like an odometer.

entries.name: License
entries.summary: One-time licence pricing driven by a single 'active users' stepper: three nested cards re-price with rolling digits, mark which tier fits best, and disable tiers the team has outgrown.

entries.name: Studio
entries.summary: Service-studio pricing in a bento of three offers with live capacity: a row of spot dots fills when you reserve, flips to a waitlist when full, and can be undone; billing toggle and add-on switch roll the prices.

entries.name: Horizon
entries.summary: Cinematic prompt-box hero for a forecasting product: type a question or drop a CSV and the headline shrinks while a history line and an amber forecast band draw along the bottom of a sunrise photo.

entries.name: Murmur
entries.summary: Voice-assistant hero centred on a WebGL orb whose surface, glow and colour follow a listen / think / speak cycle driven by the microphone, with a clearly labelled scripted fallback.

entries.name: Parlor
entries.summary: Character-chat hero: three illustrated faces act as a radio group that re-themes the page, beside a working scripted chat window that lets visitors try the product before signing up.

entries.name: Rootsong
entries.summary: A flower drawn entirely from small words on a 2D canvas; scroll opens the bloom, scatters the words upward and re-forms them into one large word, while a form lets visitors plant their own phrase.

entries.name: Signal & Soil
entries.summary: Glowing monospace glyphs form a horse, then poppies, then a wordmark over blurred pastoral photos; the pointer scatters them, and at the end they lift away as the last photo snaps into focus.

entries.name: Transmission
entries.summary: A ray-marched 3D lily shown as live ASCII on black; the pointer opens a circular lens onto the true render, and scroll refines the characters, blooms and tilts the flower, then decodes the whole screen.
